import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 50;
    static final int M = 50;
    static final int K = 50;
    static final int T = N + K + 1;
    static final int N_nodes = N * T + 1;
    static final int M_edges = K + (M * 2 * K + N) * (T - 1);
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class Edge {
        Edge next;
        int destination;

        Edge() {
            next = null;
            destination = 0;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] adj_list = new Edge[N];
    static Edge[] adj_list2 = new Edge[N_nodes];
    static Edge[] buffer_ptr1 = new Edge[1];
    static Edge[] buffer_ptr2 = new Edge[1];

    static int[] potential = new int[N_nodes];
    static int[] dist_layers = new int[N_nodes];
    static int[] back_edge = new int[N_nodes];
    static int[] heap_nodes = new int[N_nodes + 2];
    static int[] heap_index = new int[N_nodes];
    static int heap_cnt;

    static boolean heap_compare(int u, int v) {
        return potential[u] < potential[v] || (potential[u] == potential[v] && dist_layers[u] < dist_layers[v]);
    }

    static int heap_adjust(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        if (i > heap_cnt) return 0;
        if (i < heap_cnt && heap_compare(heap_nodes[i+1], heap_nodes[i])) return i+1;
        return i;
    }

    static void heap_sift_up(int node) {
        int idx = heap_index[node];
        int parent;
        while ((parent = idx / 2) != 0 && heap_compare(node, heap_nodes[parent])) {
            heap_nodes[heap_index[heap_nodes[parent]] = idx] = heap_nodes[parent];
            idx = parent;
        }
        heap_nodes[heap_index[node] = idx] = node;
    }

    static void heap_sift_down(int node) {
        int idx = heap_index[node];
        int child;
        while ((child = heap_adjust(idx)) != 0 && heap_compare(heap_nodes[child], node)) {
            heap_nodes[heap_index[heap_nodes[child]] = idx] = heap_nodes[child];
            idx = child;
        }
        heap_nodes[heap_index[node] = idx] = node;
    }

    static void heap_push(int node) {
        heap_index[node] = ++heap_cnt;
        heap_sift_up(node);
    }

    static int heap_pop() {
        int result = heap_nodes[1];
        int last = heap_nodes[heap_cnt--];
        heap_index[last] = 1;
        heap_sift_down(last);
        return result;
    }

    static void add_to_adj(int source, int target) {
        if (buffer_ptr1[0] == null) {
            buffer_ptr1[0] = new Edge();
            buffer_ptr1[0].next = new Edge[M * 2 + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < M * 2 + 1; i++) {
                buffer_ptr1[0].next[i] = new Edge();
            }
            buffer_ptr1[0] = buffer_ptr1[0].next[M * 2];
        }
        buffer_ptr1[0].destination = target;
        buffer_ptr1[0].next = adj_list[source].next;
        adj_list[source].next = buffer_ptr1[0];
        buffer_ptr1[0] = buffer_ptr1[0].next;
    }

    static void add_to_graph2(int vertex, int edge_idx) {
        if (buffer_ptr2[0] == null) {
            buffer_ptr2[0] = new Edge();
            buffer_ptr2[0].next = new Edge[M_edges * 2 + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < M_edges * 2 + 1; i++) {
                buffer_ptr2[0].next[i] = new Edge();
            }
            buffer_ptr2[0] = buffer_ptr2[0].next[M_edges * 2];
        }
        buffer_ptr2[0].destination = edge_idx;
        buffer_ptr2[0].next = adj_list2[vertex].next;
        adj_list2[vertex].next = buffer_ptr2[0];
        buffer_ptr2[0] = buffer_ptr2[0].next;
    }

    static int num_nodes, num_edges;
    static int[] from = new int[M_edges];
    static int[] to = new int[M_edges];
    static int[] XOR_uv = new int[M_edges];
    static int[] base_cost = new int[M_edges];
    static int[] reduced_cost = new int[M_edges];
    static int[] capacity = new int[M_edges * 2];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = num_edges++;
        from[h] = u;
        to[h] = v;
        XOR_uv[h] = u ^ v;
        base_cost[h] = cos;
        capacity[h * 2] = cap;
        add_to_graph2(u, h * 2);
        add_to_graph2(v, h * 2 + 1);
    }

    static void dijkstra(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(potential, INF);
        potential[source] = 0;
        heap_push(source);
        while (heap_cnt > 0) {
            Edge iter;
            int u = heap_pop();
            int v;
            int h, h_, dist;
            int new_layer = dist_layers[u] + 1;

            for (iter = adj_list2[u].next; iter != null; iter = iter.next) {
                if (capacity[h_ = iter.destination] > 0) {
                    h = h_ >> 1;
                    dist = potential[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? reduced_cost[h] : -reduced_cost[h]);
                    v = u ^ XOR_uv[h];
                    if (potential[v] == INF) {
                        potential[v] = dist;
                        dist_layers[v] = new_layer;
                        back_edge[v] = h_;
                        heap_push(v);
                    } else if (potential[v] > dist || (potential[v] == dist && dist_layers[v] > new_layer)) {
                        potential[v] = dist;
                        dist_layers[v] = new_layer;
                        back_edge[v] = h_;
                        heap_sift_up(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void push_flow(int source, int target) {
        int u, h, h_;
        for (u = target; u != source; u ^= XOR_uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = back_edge[u]) >> 1;
            capacity[h_]--;
            capacity[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int min_cost_max_flow(int src, int dst) {
        int total_flow_cost, idx;
        System.arraycopy(base_cost, 0, reduced_cost, 0, num_edges);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra(src);
            if (potential[dst] == INF) break;
            push_flow(src, dst);
            for (idx = 0; idx < num_edges; idx++) {
                int u = from[idx], v = to[idx];
                if (potential[u] != INF && potential[v] != INF)
                    reduced_cost[idx] += potential[u] - potential[v];
            }
        }
        total_flow_cost = 0;
        for (idx = 0; idx < num_edges; idx++)
            total_flow_cost += base_cost[idx] * capacity[idx * 2 + 1];
        return total_flow_cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        int c = scanner.nextInt();
        int d = scanner.nextInt();
        
        int[] starts = new int[K];
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            starts[h] = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            adj_list[i] = new Edge();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N_nodes; i++) {
            adj_list2[i] = new Edge();
        }
        
        while (m-- > 0) {
            int i = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
            int j = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
            add_to_adj(i, j);
            add_to_adj(j, i);
        }
        
        int t = n + k + 1;
        num_nodes = n * t + 1;
        num_edges = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                Edge iter;
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (iter = adj_list[i].next; iter != null; iter = iter.next) {
                    int j = iter.destination;
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        connect(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                int v = u + 1;
                connect(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            connect(num_nodes - 1, starts[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(min_cost_max_flow(num_nodes - 1, 0 * t + t - 1));
    }
}
